item.title: Preproccessors
item.description: Preproccessors are functions that transform and change the data before they are run through the AI model.

item.title: index
item.description: Guided active learning greatly improves student engagement, to accommodate this desire Datascratch comes pre-loaded with several example datasets, which have been crafted to be usable to a wide range of users, allowing novices to get learning right away, without having to procure a dataset first.

item.title: Descriptive Statistics
item.description: An easy way to view the overall skew of a dataset, as well as get some basic statistics. This tab runs every time you plot something.

item.title: Classifiers
item.description: A classifier is a type of AI model that looks at the features of an input and assigns it to a specific category.

item.title: random_data
item.description: A completely random dataset, for the purpose of teaching concepts like over fitting and other things. There is no correlation anywhere.

item.title: Stacked Bar Charts
item.description: You can plot stacked bar charts from two designated classifiers. These are a way to see the counts of each value.

item.title: Importing your own dataset
item.description: Importing your own training data To import your own training data, start by clicking on the “import dataset” button from the main menu.
